tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, so there is no build type in which verification is turned off. This sits alongside the project's standing decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, and that this fits the project's decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions.

Both statements come from current Muninn decisions: #23 ("verification on all builds") and #26 ("https everywhere, no exceptions"). The earlier records they replaced are retired, so the file doesn't mention them.

Muninn's startup context also flagged a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That may mean a hook is exceeding its timeout. I didn't investigate it.
